rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for an ability, skill, power, or mental capacity.

example.english: I don't think I have the faculty to finish this work on my own.
example.traditional: 我覺得自己冇能力一個人完成呢份工作。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 mou5 nang4 lik6 jat1 go3 jan4 jyun4 sing4 ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3

rows.note: Use this for a university division such as the Faculty of Science or Faculty of Medicine.

example.english: They study in the university's faculty of medicine.
example.jyutping: keoi5 duk6 gan2 ji1 hok6 jyun2

rows.note: Use this for the academic teaching staff of an educational institution, as distinct from students and support staff.

example.english: The university's faculty undergoes teaching evaluations every year.
example.traditional: 呢間大學嘅教學人員每年都要接受教學評估。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 daai6 hok6 ge3 gaau3 hok6 jan4 jyun4 mui5 nin4 dou1 jiu3 zip3 sau6 gaau3 hok6 ping4 gu2
